title: TCS London Marathon – Results (World Athletics)
claims: World Athletics lists the TCS London Marathon in London on 26 April 2026.
World Athletics lists Sabastian Sawe as the men's winner in 1:59:30 with WR and AR records.
World Athletics lists Tigst Assefa as the women's winner in 2:15:41 with WR and AR records.
World Athletics lists Hellen Obiri second in 2:15:53 and Joyciline Jepkosgei third in 2:15:55.
World Athletics lists Eilish McColgan seventh in 2:24:51.
